purpose: Low-cost paired objective/optimizer calibration before any new blind solver. Explicitly supplied keycycle/sign; no claim of blind recovery or unknown decryption.
old_controls: All12 E054 controls unchanged. Baseline perpage-context optimum reused from exact E054 winners; for the two failures reuse E055 known-key oracles. Never rerun unchanged completed full searches.
fresh_controls: Three heldout chapterX/XI/XII runeoffset12000,length729,periods17,23,31,signs+1,-1,+1. Random(3301056+index) uniformnonzero key; second boundary is first nonzero plaintext position at/after262 (must be<294); third boundary528. Set key[0] to that second-boundary plaintext rune,secondphase0,firstphase0,thirdphase rng.randrange(m). This intentionally forces a noncopied ciphertextF at a nonfirst page start. Independent Random(3304056+index) copies plaintextFs with probabilities.25,.5,.75. Labeled boundary-stress controls, not general random-key performance. Fresh ranges for this calibration, same excluded chapters.
paired_models: Same fixed BackoffModel order4,alpha.5,strength5,trainingI,III-IX. Compare reset-perpage score against continuous language history while keyphase can reset each page. Penalty unchanged: (m ln29 + cipherFcount ln2 + (G-1)lnm)/N.
optimizer: Exact DP over keycursor and last3 plaintextsymbols. At each nonempty page boundary retain best prefix for each history across old cursors, expand all new phases, carry history. Empty pages append phase0 and consume nothing. Normalize key orientation using firstnonempty phase. No beam pruning or oracle mask/phase. Core standard-library DP; optional NumPy coordinates used only in later blind solver.
alternatives: Retain for every coupled winner each nonfirst leading-F toggle with compensating phase +/-1, identicalciphertext. Store even if it ranks lower; no uniqueness claim. Keys containingzero may yield sameplaintext with differentrecipes.
null: One matched perpage conditional null of freshcase2,seed3302056+page_index. Compare both optimizers with the same injected sourcekey; diagnostic fixedkey null only, no inference or pvalue.
gate: Require all15 original/fresh controls exactplaintext,keyorientation,mask,phases for coupled optimizer before declaring this objective calibrated. Failure blocks unknown use; preserve failures and oracle labels. Exact small exhaustive tests also required. A later blind experiment has its own gate and fresh controls.
bounds: <=4096runes,<=16pages,each nonempty>=4runes,keys<=32,states<=16*m*m (16384),oneprocess,180seconds,phase20total1500seconds. Process768MiB sampled resident/private ceiling. Bound violation aborts without heuristic pruning.
limits: Continuous context may not match actual LP page relationships. Better ranking cannot remove non-injectivity. Control-generation key edit uses truth only to construct a stress case; all optimizer calls are explicitly oracle diagnostics. No new unknown scan.
